topic: Annual CO2 emissions from fossil fuels
metric: Annual CO2 emissions from fossil fuels

interpretations.label: Territorial Emissions
interpretations.description: CO2 emissions produced directly within a country's geographical borders from fossil fuel combustion and industrial processes.
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Million metric tons of carbon dioxide (MtCO2) per year
caveats: Does not account for emissions embedded in international trade (imported or exported goods).

interpretations.label: Consumption-based Emissions
interpretations.description: CO2 emissions allocated to the country where goods and services are ultimately consumed.
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Million metric tons of carbon dioxide (MtCO2) per year adjusted for trade balance
caveats: Relies on complex multi-regional input-output models with higher uncertainty and reporting lags.

preferredSources: EDGAR (Emissions Database for Global Atmospheric Research)
knownRisks: Final validated data for 2023 and 2024 may be preliminary or estimated.
Discrepancies can occur between top-down atmospheric inversions and bottom-up national inventories.
